sections.title: Gold Skulltulas
sections.note: Kill one, then grab its token. Tags give the age, Night for night-only ones, and the items needed.

items.name: Behind the Know-It-All Brothers' house
items.area: Back wall of the Know-It-All Brothers' house
items.howTo: At night, go round the back of the Know-It-All Brothers' house and slash the Gold Skulltula on the wall, then jump or backflip to grab the token.

items.name: Soft soil by the Kokiri Shop
items.area: Soft soil patch beside the Kokiri Shop
items.howTo: Release a bottled Bug on the soft soil patch next to the Kokiri Shop to make the Gold Skulltula pop out.

items.name: On the House of Twins
items.area: Top/back of the House of Twins
items.howTo: As an adult at night, hit the Gold Skulltula on the House of Twins with the Hookshot and pull in the token.

items.name: Soft soil near the bridge
items.area: Clearing with the bridge to Hyrule Field (left, left from the Kokiri entrance)
items.howTo: From the Kokiri Forest entrance go left, then left again to the bridge clearing and release a bottled Bug on the soft soil.

items.name: Soft soil near the Deku Theater
items.area: Clearing with the Deku Theater hole and two Business Scrubs (right, left, right, left, left)
items.howTo: Go right, left, right, left, left from the entrance to the clearing with the hole to the Deku Theater and release a bottled Bug on the soft soil.

items.name: Ledge above the Deku Theater
items.area: High ledge in the Deku Theater clearing
items.howTo: Plant a Magic Bean in the theater clearing's soft soil as a child; as an adult at night, ride the bean plant up to the ledge and kill the Gold Skulltula there.

items.name: On the east wall of the maze
items.area: Upper level of the maze, east wall
items.howTo: As an adult at night, climb the ladder in the maze to the upper ledge, look at the wall to the left (east) and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

items.name: Grotto by the tree near Kakariko
items.area: Secret grotto under the lone tree between the Castle Town bridge and Kakariko Village
items.howTo: Bomb the base of the lone tree north of the Castle Town–Kakariko bridge to open a grotto; kill the Gold Skulltula high on the web wall (past the Big Skulltula) and fetch the token with the Boomerang or Hookshot.
items.notes: Adults can use the Hookshot instead of the Boomerang.

items.name: Cow grotto near Gerudo Valley
items.area: Secret grotto under the ring of stones near the Gerudo Valley entrance
items.howTo: Bomb the centre of the ring of stones near Gerudo Valley to open a grotto, burn the webs with Din's Fire (or Fire Arrows), and get the Gold Skulltula high on the wall behind the cow with the Boomerang or Hookshot.
items.notes: Fire Arrows can replace Din's Fire and the Hookshot can replace the Boomerang as an adult. StrategyWiki says to lift/destroy the boulder in the centre first.

items.name: Crate in the guard house
items.area: Guard house just inside the drawbridge
items.howTo: Enter the guard house on the right just past the drawbridge and roll into the crates along the back wall until a Gold Skulltula pops out.

items.name: Tree on the castle path
items.area: Lone tree with three rocks at its base, just past the Market gate
items.howTo: On the road up to Hyrule Castle, roll into the lone tree ringed by three rocks to knock down the Gold Skulltula.

items.name: Song of Storms grotto
items.area: Grotto under the tree in the corner by the castle moat/gate
items.howTo: Play the Song of Storms by the lone tree in the corner near the castle gate to open a grotto, bomb the cracked walls inside until the Gold Skulltula is revealed, and grab the token with the Boomerang.
items.notes: StrategyWiki, Zelda Dungeon and Flying Omelette only mention Bombs; GameWith says to retrieve the token with the Boomerang (it is up on the wall).

items.name: Behind the ruined castle gate
items.area: Back of the broken stone archway to the right (east) of Ganon's Castle
items.howTo: As an adult, follow the path to the right of Ganon's Castle past the ruined archway, turn around, and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on its back side.
items.notes: Grouping differs: StrategyWiki ('Ganon's Castle (Exterior)'), Zelda Dungeon and GameWith ('Ganon's Castle') list it separately; Zelda Wiki's Hyrule Castle page counts only the 2 child-era tokens. The in-game Hyrule Castle map area covers this spot.

items.name: Tree by the ranch house
items.area: Lone tree next to the ranch house
items.howTo: Roll into the lone tree beside the ranch house to knock down the Gold Skulltula.

items.name: Behind the feeding shelter
items.area: Back of the horse shelter on the far side of the corral
items.howTo: At night, go round the outside of the corral to the back of the horses' feeding shelter and kill the Gold Skulltula on it.

items.name: Ranch house window
items.area: Upper window of Talon's ranch house
items.howTo: At night, kill the Gold Skulltula on the ranch house's upper window and fetch the token with the Boomerang.

items.name: High on the back wall
items.area: Outer wall to the right of the silo, south-west of the ranch
items.howTo: At night, look high on the ranch's outer wall to the right of the silo, kill the Gold Skulltula and fetch the token with the Boomerang.

items.name: Tree near the entrance
items.area: Large tree just inside the village entrance
items.howTo: At night, roll into the large tree straight ahead of the village entrance to knock down the Gold Skulltula.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon and GameWith do not mention night; StrategyWiki and Flying Omelette list it as night (it is a night spawn).

items.name: Side of the House of Skulltula
items.area: Outer wall of the House of Skulltula
items.howTo: At night, kill the Gold Skulltula on the side/back wall of the House of Skulltula, below a window.

items.name: House under construction
items.area: Brick pile inside the unfinished house in the village centre
items.howTo: At night, check the bricks of the house the carpenters are building in the middle of the village for a Gold Skulltula.

items.name: House by the Death Mountain gate
items.area: Wall of the house left of the gate to Death Mountain Trail
items.howTo: At night, look on the side of the house next to the Death Mountain gate (near three pots) for a Gold Skulltula.

items.name: Watchtower ladder
items.area: Ladder of the lookout tower
items.howTo: At night, shoot the Gold Skulltula on the watchtower ladder with the Slingshot (or a Bombchu), then climb up to collect the token.
items.notes: A Bombchu also works instead of the Slingshot.

items.name: On top of Impa's house
items.area: Roof of Impa's house / cliff behind it
items.howTo: As an adult at night, stand by Impa's house door, Hookshot onto the House of Skulltula roof, then Hookshot over to Impa's roof and kill the Gold Skulltula.
items.notes: Easier with the Longshot. StrategyWiki says a child dropped on the roof by Kaepora Gaebora can't get it in the US version.

items.name: Soft soil in the graveyard
items.area: Soft soil patch on the left (north-west) side
items.howTo: Release a bottled Bug on the soft soil patch on the left side of the graveyard.

items.name: Wall near the Royal Family's Tomb
items.area: Wall at the end of the upper row of graves (south-east corner)
items.howTo: At night, kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall at the end of the upper row of graves and fetch the token with the Boomerang.

items.name: Soft soil by Dodongo's Cavern
items.area: Soft soil outside the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern
items.howTo: Once the boulder in front of Dodongo's Cavern is gone, release a bottled Bug on the soft soil next to the entrance.

items.name: Behind the cracked wall near Kakariko
items.area: Cracked wall on the right of the trail, near the Kakariko end
items.howTo: Bomb the cracked wall on the trail before Dodongo's Cavern, kill the Gold Skulltula behind it, then climb the wall (or use the Boomerang) to get the token.
items.notes: Flying Omelette and GameWith say to collect the token with the Boomerang; StrategyWiki and Zelda Dungeon say climb the wall.

items.name: Red rock above Dodongo's Cavern
items.area: Red boulder where the Bomb Flower was, just above Dodongo's Cavern
items.howTo: As an adult at night, smash the red boulder at the Bomb Flower spot above Dodongo's Cavern with the Megaton Hammer and kill the Gold Skulltula behind it.

items.name: Red rock near the summit
items.area: Red boulder at the base of the climbable wall below the summit
items.howTo: As an adult at night, smash the red boulder at the foot of the climbable cliff near the summit (the one closest to the top) with the Megaton Hammer to reveal a Gold Skulltula.
items.notes: Can be done without the Hammer using a magic spin attack and a backflip into the rock (StrategyWiki).

items.name: Crate in the boulder maze
items.area: Back of the top-floor boulder maze room
items.howTo: On the top floor, bomb your way through the boulder maze room to the far end (two chests, a Gossip Stone) and roll into the crate there.

items.name: Back of the central pedestal
items.area: Back of the pedestal at the top of the city's centre
items.howTo: As an adult, walk out on one of the ropes until you can see the back of the central pedestal where the Goron's Ruby rested and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.
items.notes: StrategyWiki marks it night-only; Zelda Dungeon, Flying Omelette and GameWith don't.

items.name: Crate at the summit entrance
items.area: Crate just inside the crater from the Death Mountain summit
items.howTo: Enter the crater from the summit of Death Mountain and roll into the crate near the entrance.

items.name: Soft soil by the warp pad
items.area: Soft soil next to the Bolero of Fire warp pad
items.howTo: After learning the Bolero of Fire as an adult, go back to the past and warp to the crater as a child, then release a bottled Bug on the soft soil near the warp pad.

items.name: Tree at the river entrance
items.area: Tree on the left at the start of the river
items.howTo: Roll into the tree at the start of Zora's River to knock down the Gold Skulltula.

items.name: Ladder by the waterfall
items.area: Ladder out of the water at the top of the river, near the waterfall
items.howTo: At night, drop into the shallow water at the upper end of the river, kill the Gold Skulltula on the ladder with the Slingshot or Boomerang, then climb up for the token.
items.notes: The Boomerang works too.

items.name: High on the south wall
items.area: South wall above the central plateau (by the raised grottos)
items.howTo: As an adult at night, get onto the tall central plateau (bean plant or the ladder from the narrow stream) and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula high on the south wall.
items.notes: StrategyWiki says the Longshot is needed from the ground, or the Hookshot from the plateau; Zelda Dungeon uses the Hookshot from the plateau.

items.name: Above the bridge to Zora's Domain
items.area: Wall at the bend before the Zora's Domain entrance
items.howTo: As an adult at night, stand on the last bridge/fence before the Zora's Domain entrance, turn around and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula high on the wall.

items.name: Top of the frozen waterfall
items.area: Ledge at the top of the frozen waterfall, reached from King Zora's chamber
items.howTo: As an adult at night, go through King Zora's chamber to the edge above the frozen waterfall, look left and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

items.name: Tree near the Great Fairy
items.area: Lone tree on the south-east shore
items.howTo: Roll into the lone tree near the Great Fairy's Fountain to knock down the Gold Skulltula.

items.name: Wall above the log
items.area: Wall behind the big floating log south of Lord Jabu-Jabu
items.howTo: At night, stand on the large log near Lord Jabu-Jabu, turn around and get the Gold Skulltula on the wall with the Boomerang.

items.name: Hidden cave under the silver rock
items.area: Cave beneath the silver boulder near the Great Fairy's Fountain
items.howTo: As an adult at night, lift the silver boulder with the Silver Gauntlets, bomb the rock underneath, drop in, pass the invisible Skulltulas (Lens of Truth helps) and climb to the end, then Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the wall.
items.notes: StrategyWiki says to use the Longshot.

items.name: Soft soil by the laboratory
items.area: Soft soil next to the Lakeside Laboratory
items.howTo: Release a bottled Bug on the soft soil next to the Lakeside Laboratory.

items.name: Laboratory back wall
items.area: Back wall of the Lakeside Laboratory, seen from the bridge
items.howTo: At night, step onto the bridge behind the Lakeside Laboratory, look left at the lab wall and get the Gold Skulltula with the Boomerang.

items.name: Pillar on the small island
items.area: Small island with two pillars (Fire Arrows island)
items.howTo: At night, swim to the small island with two pillars (where the Fire Arrows are shot later) and kill the Gold Skulltula on one of the pillars.

items.name: Crate in the lab pool
items.area: Crate at the bottom of the Lakeside Laboratory pool
items.howTo: Inside the Lakeside Laboratory, sink to the bottom of the pool with the Iron Boots, roll into the crate and kill the Gold Skulltula with the Hookshot.
items.notes: StrategyWiki marks it night-only; the other sources don't, and it's indoors. The Zora Tunic helps.

items.name: Top of the dead tree
items.area: Dead tree on the island with the warp pad (above the Water Temple)
items.howTo: As an adult at night, Longshot to the top of the dead tree on the warp-pad island and kill the Gold Skulltula there.

items.name: Above the small waterfall
items.area: Water spout on the cliff by the small wooden bridge at the valley entrance
items.howTo: At night, at the small wooden bridge near the entrance, look right at the water pouring from the cliff and get the Gold Skulltula there with the Boomerang.

items.name: Soft soil by the cow
items.area: Soft soil on the ledge with the Gerudo and her cow, down by the river
items.howTo: Grab the Cucco by the big bridge and glide down to the ledge with the Gerudo and her cow, then release a bottled Bug on the soft soil.

items.name: Behind the carpenters' tent
items.area: Rock wall behind the carpenters' tent
items.howTo: As an adult at night, go behind the carpenters' tent and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the rock wall.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon says Longshot; StrategyWiki says Hookshot or Longshot.

items.name: Under the rock arch
items.area: Stone archway left of the path to Gerudo's Fortress, in front of the tent
items.howTo: As an adult at night, look at the underside of the stone arch near the carpenters' tent and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula.

items.name: On the far archery target
items.area: Last target of the Horseback Archery range
items.howTo: As an adult at night, walk to the far target of the horseback archery range and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on its face.
items.notes: Best done once you have the Gerudo Membership Card, so the guards leave you alone.

items.name: Top of the fortress
items.area: Rock wall in the gap near the Piece of Heart chest on the fortress roof
items.howTo: As an adult at night, climb to the top of the fortress and look in the gap before the chest platform; Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the rock wall (or jump to it).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon says Longshot; StrategyWiki says Hookshot, Longshot, or just jump.

items.name: Inside the stone structure
items.area: Basement of the stone shelter where the Poe guide waits
items.howTo: Cross the River of Sand with the Longshot, follow the flags to the stone structure, drop into its basement and kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall between the torches.
items.notes: Hover Boots can also cross the River of Sand.

items.name: Soft soil by the Spirit Temple
items.area: Soft soil left of the Spirit Temple entrance
items.howTo: As a child (warp in with the Requiem of Spirit), release a bottled Bug on the soft soil near the Spirit Temple entrance.

items.name: Palm tree by the oasis
items.area: Top of a palm tree beside the dried-up oasis
items.howTo: As an adult at night, Longshot the Gold Skulltula on the crown of the palm tree next to the dried-up oasis.

items.name: Plateau on the bean ride
items.area: Rock plateau on the Magic Bean platform's route
items.howTo: Plant a Magic Bean in the soft soil near the Spirit Temple as a child; as an adult at night, ride the bean platform and jump off at its second stop to kill the Gold Skulltula.
items.notes: Can also be Longshotted from the back of the rock (StrategyWiki).

items.name: Compass room alcove
items.area: Left alcove of the 3F (Compass) room, behind the small chest
items.howTo: In the Compass room, raise the platforms and jump to the left alcove; the Gold Skulltula is on the wall behind the small chest.

items.name: Basement vines
items.area: Vines leading from B1 back up to 1F
items.howTo: After falling through the web to the basement, shoot the Gold Skulltula on the vines with the Slingshot and climb up to the token.

items.name: Basement gate
items.area: Bars/grate at the north end of B1
items.howTo: In the basement, kill the Gold Skulltula on the grate (Slingshot or sword) and jump from the nearby ledge to grab the token.

items.name: Basement back room
items.area: Hidden B1 room past the room with three Gohma Larvae
items.howTo: Return with Bombs and the Boomerang: in the basement room with the Gohma Larvae, burn the web, bomb the cracked wall, and use the Boomerang on the Gold Skulltula in the room beyond.
items.notes: A Deku Stick lights the web. The room doesn't show on the N64 dungeon map until visited (fixed in 3DS).

items.name: Side room off the Baby Dodongo corridor
items.area: Room behind a weak wall in the south-east corridor
items.howTo: From the main hall take the south-east door into the winding Baby Dodongo corridor, blow open the weak wall (bomb or a Baby Dodongo's explosion) and kill the Gold Skulltula among the Keese.
items.notes: A Baby Dodongo's explosion can open the wall before you have Bombs.

items.name: Vines by the big staircase
items.area: Vine wall near the top of the large staircase room
items.howTo: In the room with the big staircase, climb up and shoot the Gold Skulltula on the vines with the Slingshot, then climb up to the token.
items.notes: Adults can use the Bow or Hookshot.

items.name: Behind the Armos
items.area: Hidden room behind a bombable wall, beyond the Armos
items.howTo: Inside the giant Dodongo skull area, go right into the room with low walls and Fire Keese, bomb the fake wall at the far (north) end and kill the Gold Skulltula behind the Armos statue.

items.name: Alcove above the staircase
items.area: Cubby at the top of the large staircase
items.howTo: Come back to the staircase room via the second floor, climb the side wall/vines to reach the alcove above the stairs and fetch the token with the Boomerang.
items.notes: As an adult, the Longshot from the side bridges reaches it.

items.name: Scarecrow ledge in the corridor
items.area: High alcove in the corridor before the first Lizalfos fight
items.howTo: As an adult who knows the Scarecrow's Song, play it at the high alcove Navi flies to in the corridor before the first Lizalfos fight, Hookshot to Pierre and kill the Gold Skulltula.
items.notes: StrategyWiki lists it as either age because a child can reach it by pushing a statue and backflipping; in 3DS the backflip trick differs.

items.name: Vines in the water-switch room
items.area: Vine wall in the room with the water-raising switch
items.howTo: While carrying Ruto, go to the room with the floor switch, shoot the Gold Skulltula on the vine wall with the Slingshot, then raise the water and climb the vines for the token.

items.name: Basement wall (near Bigocto)
items.area: Wall by the door to Bigocto's room, after dropping through the hole
items.howTo: After dropping through the hole where the green tentacle was, kill the Gold Skulltula closer to Bigocto's door and grab its token with the Boomerang.

items.name: Basement wall (far from Bigocto)
items.area: Same wall, further from Bigocto's door
items.howTo: In the same room, kill the second Gold Skulltula further from Bigocto's door and grab its token with the Boomerang.
items.notes: Flying Omelette notes you may need to be on the high ledge to reach this token.

items.name: Vines before Barinade
items.area: Vine wall in the room before the boss
items.howTo: In the room before Barinade, shoot the Gold Skulltula on the vine wall with the Slingshot or Boomerang and climb up to the token.
items.notes: The Slingshot also works.

items.name: Entrance vines
items.area: Top of the vines on the right in the first room
items.howTo: In the first room, climb the vines on the right and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula at the top.

items.name: Lobby wall by the north door
items.area: Wall to the right of the north door in the main hall
items.howTo: In the main hall, go up to the north door, turn right and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the dark wall.

items.name: East courtyard
items.area: Wall near the raised island with a chest in the east courtyard
items.howTo: In the east (raised-island) courtyard, Hookshot the chest to get onto the island, then Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the nearby wall.

items.name: West courtyard
items.area: High wall above the narrow ledge with recovery hearts
items.howTo: In the west courtyard, get onto the narrow ledge with two hearts (from the room above) and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the wall in front.
items.notes: Can be Longshotted from the ground.

items.name: Basement rotating walls
items.area: Alcove behind the rotating wall in the basement before the boss
items.howTo: In the basement with the rotating walls, push the wall around until the alcove with the Gold Skulltula opens and Hookshot it.

items.name: Song of Time room
items.area: Room above the Time Block on the left of the big lava (broken bridge) room
items.howTo: In the lava room with the broken bridge, play the Song of Time to move the Time Block, climb to the door above and kill the Gold Skulltula on the back wall past the Flare tiles and Like Like.

items.name: Bombable wall in the boulder maze
items.area: Hidden alcove behind a bombable wall on the boulder maze's ground floor
items.howTo: In the boulder maze, find the hollow-sounding wall (left, left, right, then straight on from the entrance) and bomb it to reveal the Gold Skulltula.

items.name: Scarecrow route: climbing fence
items.area: Chain fence in the hidden area above the boulder maze
items.howTo: On top of the boulder maze walls, play the Scarecrow's Song where Navi turns green, Hookshot to Pierre, then to the platform that lifts you to a hidden area; the Gold Skulltula is on the climbing fence.

items.name: Scarecrow route: top room
items.area: Wall of the round room with the fire-ringed chest at the top of the hidden area
items.howTo: Keep climbing past the previous one to the round room with the chest in flames and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the wall.

items.name: Boss Key loop tile room
items.area: Flare-tile and Like Like room after the Fire Keese and Torch Slug room
items.howTo: On the Boss Key loop, enter the room after the one with Fire Keese and Torch Slugs; beat the Flare tiles and Like Like to find the Gold Skulltula on the back wall.
items.notes: Past the loop that the Megaton Hammer opens. GameWith puts it past the door beside the entrance stairs; Zelda Dungeon, just before the second Flare Dancer.

items.name: Spinning blade room
items.area: High wall in the first spinning-blade room with Silver Rupees
items.howTo: In the first spinning-blade room, Hookshot the Gold Skulltula high on the wall between the ice sheets, above one of the Silver Rupees.

items.name: Compass room
items.area: High pillar in the room with the Compass and the Piece of Heart in red ice
items.howTo: Melt the red ice with Blue Fire to reach the Compass room, then Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the high ice pillar.

items.name: Ice block room
items.area: Wall of the sliding ice block room
items.howTo: In the large sliding-ice-block room, Hookshot the Gold Skulltula on the upper wall.
items.notes: Blue Fire is needed to get into this part of the cavern.

items.name: Behind the gate (south corridor)
items.area: Behind the gate at the end of the south corridor on the lowest level
items.howTo: With the water fully drained, bomb the floor in the south passage, cross with the Hookshot, then hit the crystal switch behind the bars with a spin attack and kill the Gold Skulltula behind the gate.
items.notes: 3DS: the crystal switch is no longer behind the gate, so a spin attack isn't needed.

items.name: Underground river
items.area: Wall above a whirlpool in the river with vortexes
items.howTo: After getting the Longshot, sink in the whirlpool river with the Iron Boots and Longshot the Gold Skulltula on the left wall.

items.name: Inside the central pillar
items.area: Top wall inside the central pillar
items.howTo: Go inside the central pillar, climb to the upper floor, and Longshot the Gold Skulltula at the top of the room.

items.name: Falling-platform waterfall room
items.area: Wall in the top-floor west room with platforms falling down the waterfall
items.howTo: On the top floor, in the room where Hookshot platforms descend the waterfall, look right and Longshot the Gold Skulltula.

items.name: Rolling-boulder waterfall
items.area: Wall beside the small waterfall in the rolling-boulder corridor before the Boss Key
items.howTo: In the corridor with rolling boulders before the Boss Key, inch to the ledge by the small waterfall, look right and Longshot the Gold Skulltula.

items.name: Like Like room
items.area: Wall of the north-east room with a Like Like and a small chest
items.howTo: From the centre take the north-east route (crawlspace and locked door, past the invisible pits) to the Like Like room, kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall and get the token with the Boomerang.
items.notes: Needs a Small Key.

items.name: Left locked room
items.area: Left locked room of the central area (Deku Baba and flying pots)
items.howTo: Open the left locked door in the central area with a Small Key, then kill the Gold Skulltula on the back wall and get the token with the Boomerang.
items.notes: Needs a Small Key.

items.name: Right locked room
items.area: Right locked room of the central area (Keese around a pit)
items.howTo: Open the right locked door in the central area, follow the invisible path around the pit with the Lens of Truth, then kill the Gold Skulltula and get the token with the Boomerang.
items.notes: Needs a Small Key.

items.name: Invisible blades / Like Like room
items.area: Room reached by invisible platforms to the left of the Stalfos platform room
items.howTo: After the guillotine path and the Stalfos, follow the invisible path on the left with the Lens of Truth; defeat the Like Like and Keese to open the gate and kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall.
items.notes: Sources differ on the room: StrategyWiki says it's in the invisible spinning-blade room; Zelda Dungeon, GameWith and Flying Omelette put it in the room beyond. StrategyWiki says Longshot; others name no item.

items.name: Falling spikes room cage
items.area: Inside a cell on the left in the falling-spike ceiling room
items.howTo: In the falling-spike room, push the hidden block (Lens of Truth) under the spikes, then check the cage on the left for the Gold Skulltula.
items.notes: Reach it through the bars with the Hookshot.

items.name: Behind the giant skull pot
items.area: Wall behind the large burning skull pot
items.howTo: In the room with the big skull pot (bomb it for a Small Key), kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall behind the skull.
items.notes: StrategyWiki says Longshot; other sources name no item.

items.name: Scarecrow ledge by the boat
items.area: High ledge in the boat room
items.howTo: In the boat room, play the Scarecrow's Song from the platform by the boat, Longshot to Pierre and kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall.
items.notes: StrategyWiki: without the Scarecrow's Song you can Longshot it from the boat before riding it.

items.name: Behind the three skull pots
items.area: Wall behind three spinning skull pots, west of the invisible-wall maze
items.howTo: In the room with three spinning skull pots (near the Boss Key area), kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall behind them.
items.notes: StrategyWiki says Longshot; other sources name no item.

items.name: Chain-link fence (child side)
items.area: Fence in the Silver Rupee room past the child crawlspace (on the right)
items.howTo: As a child, go through the crawlspace and the door on the right; collect the Silver Rupees to lower the bridge and get the Gold Skulltula on the fence with the Boomerang.

items.name: Child climbing room
items.area: Climbable wall in the vertical shaft after the Lizalfos (Bombchu-puzzle room)
items.howTo: After the Lizalfos fight, climb the wall (with two normal Skulltulas) to the next floor, turn round and get the Gold Skulltula with the Boomerang.
items.notes: As an adult, the Hookshot works.

items.name: Above the door before the Iron Knuckle
items.area: Narrow hall leading to the first Iron Knuckle fight
items.howTo: In the hall before the first Iron Knuckle, turn back to the door you came through; the Gold Skulltula is above it. Get the token with the Boomerang.
items.notes: As an adult, the Hookshot works.

items.name: Behind the Time Block (boulder room)
items.area: Behind the blue Time Block in the rolling-boulder Silver Rupee room
items.howTo: As an adult, play the Song of Time at the blue block in the rolling-boulder room and kill the Gold Skulltula behind where it stood.
items.notes: It sits high up: reach it with the Hookshot (or knock it down with the Bow or a Bombchu).

items.name: Scarecrow ledge in the statue room
items.area: Ledge on the west wall of the giant statue room
items.howTo: As an adult, play the Scarecrow's Song at the top of the west staircase in the statue room, Longshot to Pierre and kill the Gold Skulltula there.
items.notes: The Scarecrow's Song is the intended route, but the Gold Skulltula can be Longshotted straight from the top of the stairs (StrategyWiki).

sections.title: House of Skulltula
sections.note: Each of the cursed family's sons is freed as your token count passes his number.

items.name: 10 tokens
items.area: House of Skulltula
items.howTo: With 10 Gold Skulltula Tokens, talk to the son freed from the curse in the House of Skulltula, Kakariko Village.
items.notes: Wallet upgrade, holds up to 200 Rupees.

items.name: 20 tokens
items.area: House of Skulltula
items.howTo: With 20 Gold Skulltula Tokens, talk to the son freed from the curse in the House of Skulltula, Kakariko Village.
items.notes: Makes the Rumble Pak vibrate near hidden grottos and secrets. In 3DS it's the Shard of Agony, which chimes and shows an icon instead.

items.name: 30 tokens
items.area: House of Skulltula
items.howTo: With 30 Gold Skulltula Tokens, talk to the son freed from the curse in the House of Skulltula, Kakariko Village.
items.notes: Wallet upgrade, holds up to 500 Rupees.

items.name: 40 tokens
items.area: House of Skulltula
items.howTo: With 40 Gold Skulltula Tokens, talk to the son freed from the curse in the House of Skulltula, Kakariko Village.
items.notes: Ten Bombchus.

items.name: 50 tokens
items.area: House of Skulltula
items.howTo: With 50 Gold Skulltula Tokens, talk to the son freed from the curse in the House of Skulltula, Kakariko Village.
items.notes: One quarter of a Heart Container.

items.name: 100 tokens
items.area: House of Skulltula
items.howTo: With 100 Gold Skulltula Tokens, talk to the son freed from the curse in the House of Skulltula, Kakariko Village.
items.notes: The Cursed Rich Man is freed and gives a Huge Rupee worth 200 Rupees. He gives another each time you leave the house, come back and talk to him (repeatable).
